text:
maria-support: FYI — Customer (acct 99321) says they requested a refund but a credit note was created instead. Escalating, looks like tool selection picked the wrong action.
julie-cs: Customer says charge failed, asked for refund, CS created support case #S-4842 and requested automatic refund via API.
sam-autorouter: Can you paste the original request payload and any router logs?
maria-support: Pasting sanitized request from our logs:```json
{
  "user_id": "u_99321",
  "request": "refund",
  "invoice_id": "inv_7832",
  "amount": ""  // empty string from UI
}
```
Note: UI sometimes submits empty string for optional amount when customer clicks auto-refund.
devbot: [router-log] 2026-11-08T14:02:10Z router-v2 decision: candidate_scores={create_note:0.72,create_refund:0.28}. Selected create_note. decision_reason="signature_match_priority + missing_numeric_amount_fallback"
alex-eng: Looks like the refund tool requires amount:number in strict schema, but because amount came through as empty string the signature matcher considered it incompatible and fell back to create_note which accepts a freeform note plus optional metadata. The autorouter scored create_note higher.
sam-autorouter: Repro steps I ran:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.cloud/route -d '{"request":"refund","invoice_id":"inv_7832","amount":""}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer x'
2) router logs show fallback to create_note when amount not numeric.
3) If you send amount as 0 or as numeric string without empty, create_refund wins.

Command output (snippet):```
INFO router: routing_request id=rt_abc
DEBUG matcher: signature_match(create_refund)=0.22
DEBUG matcher: signature_match(create_note)=0.68
INFO router: selected=create_note
```
lena-sre: Impact note: We saw a small latency spike during the cache warmup window (12:58–14:10 UTC) which increased fuzzy-match behaviour due to degraded KV cache for tool signatures. Probably why scores were closer and fallback chosen. Only 3 customers reported wrong-action during that window.
maria-support: So root causes: malformed amount (empty string) + signature gap + cache warmup. What are recommendations? :eyes:
alex-eng: Proposed fix: 1) tighten create_refund signature to coerce/require numeric amount (server-side validation) — if amount missing, explicitly reject instead of letting matcher fallback. 2) add explicit alias/intent mapping: request=="refund" should increase base score for create_refund. 3) add a quick sanitization step that converts empty-string amounts to null and triggers explicit validation error.
sam-autorouter: I can implement the alias boost in the routing rules. Alex, can you handle schema change? We'll canary deploy.
devbot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for router-config v2.1 to 3% of traffic.
alex-eng: Patch ready, tightened schema + validation error emitted when amount missing. Will include a migration note and add unit tests. Planning canary now.
maria-support: For this customer, CS requested we do a manual refund and mark the note for reversal. Julie, can you follow up with the customer once manual refund is done? :white_check_mark:
julie-cs: On it, I’ll process manual refund and notify acct 99321 after engineering confirms canary.
sam-autorouter: After canary, we'll monitor selection score deltas and CLIs to ensure create_refund > create_note for refund-intent payloads. I’ll add a dashboard panel for signature match deltas.
maria-support: Thanks team. Filing internal ticket INF-3097 for tracking remediation & CS outreach. :thumbsup:
